response.overview: Nabila and Adam are famous YouTuber couple who received 20 thousand likes for their channel in a short period of time. To ensure their popularity remains and to thank their subscribers, they plan to publish a vlog series titled "Duet Desa", which documents their vacation across Malaysia while exploring traditional cultures. For the first episode, Nabila chooses Negeri Sembilan, a state famous for its Minangkabau culture. However, they get lost on their way to the destination due to heavy rain that disrupts their GPS and telecommunications network. When they discover Homestay Abadi, owned by a beautiful woman named Suraya, they decide to stay there. They later realize they are trapped in the homestay after strange occurrences and mysterious murders take place. Now they must find a way out before they too become victims of the dangerous homestay owner.
response.title: Sinopsis filem Suraya
